_doc: The Referral Connection campaign's Revenue OS settings: which functions are on, where each starts from in this pack, and what each waits on. Names of things only. Check with python3 tools/check_campaign.py campaigns/referral-connection/campaign.json.

grok.account: one Grok account for both campaigns

offer: a free listing in a directory where businesses find each other for collaborations, partnerships, sponsorships, deals and commission referral campaigns
icp: business owners who want a partner: someone to collaborate with, sponsor or be sponsored by, do a deal with, or swap referral campaigns with

crm.name: the site's own records, through its admin API (tools/rc.py): sign-ups, listings, connection requests, matches
crm.note: No other system writes these records. The bot writes them once context/owners.md says referral-site: bot. If the separate referral-connection pack is ever installed on another bot, that is a second writer: one of the two is switched off first.

sending.cold_email: undecided (the domain decision; a sender address for member email is not set)
sending.one_to_one: the sender address Justin names for member email

engines.note: Justin, 2026-11-24: "we sign into Claude Code CLI and Codex CLI, so we keep our costs down". Every CLI call goes through engines/route.py.

dream-100.waits_on: nothing to build the list and draft; a first touch going out waits on Justin's yes per draft

dream-500.waits_on: nothing to build and place the list; sending waits on a sending tool and inboxes

partners.waits_on: not one of the agents in this install (Justin's list, 2026-11-24). Dream 500 keeps the partner tier. On his word it becomes its own agent

cold-email.waits_on: the launch area; a sender address; the domain decision for volume

lead-radar.waits_on: nothing to read and judge; reads past the free ones are spend

content.waits_on: a brand account per outlet and who publishes on each

speaker.waits_on: the speaker profile (name, title, topics, proof). A switch: Justin said "I wouldn't do SpeakerAgent for Find Me Money" on 2026-11-20 and listed SpeakerAgent in the Revenue OS on 2026-11-24; set state off to switch it off for this campaign

aeo-seo.source: skills/guide-publisher, skills/site-check, tools/rc.py (guides save as drafts on the site); agents/aeo-seo/, campaigns/referral-connection/settings/aeo-seo.json
aeo-seo.waits_on: Search Console verification; Justin's yes to the first published guide; the full SEO kit sits in the site's private repo

sales-crm.waits_on: the site's admin key; 'referral-site: bot'; a sender address for introductions

site_scope_note: The site today is built for commission referral campaigns between local businesses. Justin, 2026-11-20: the site is for clients who want collaborations, partnerships, sponsorships and deals with others. Guides, outreach and matching cover all four from now; a change to the site's own pages or sign-up form is made in the site's repo, and the bot writes the brief for it.
